# Game Idea: Cosmic Courier

Pilot a small ship at the bottom of an HTML canvas, moving left/right to dodge falling asteroids and collect floating packages. Each collision with an asteroid ends the game, and a countdown timer forces quick decision‑making. Simple controls (arrow keys) make it easy to prototype and expand.

1: // Simple Cosmic Courier game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5:   const W = canvas.width = 400;
6:   const H = canvas.height = 600;
7:   // Audio setup
8:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
9:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
10:   function beep(freq, duration) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'sine';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   // Ship
23:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: W / 2 - 20, y: H - 30, speed: 4 };
24:   // Game state
25:   const asteroids = [];
26:   const packages = [];
27:   let left = false, right = false;
28:   let timer = 30; // seconds
29:   let lastTime = performance.now();
30:   // Ensure AudioContext resumes after user interaction
31:   document.addEventListener('click', () => audioCtx.resume(), { once: true });
32:   // Input
33:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = true; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = true; });
34:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = false; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = false; });
35:   function spawnAsteroid() {
36:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
37:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
38:   }
39:   function spawnPackage() {
40:     const size = 15;
41:     packages.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 });
42:   }
43:   function update(dt) {
44:     // Ship movement
45:     if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed; if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
46:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
47:     // Spawn
48:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
49:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnPackage();
50:     // Update asteroids
51:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
52:       const a = asteroids[i];
53:       a.y += a.speed;
54:       // collision with ship
55:       if (a.y + a.r * 2 > ship.y && a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.r * 2 > ship.x) {
56:         beep(200, 0.2); // collision sound
57:         endGame();
58:         return;
59:       }
60:       if (a.y - a.r > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
61:     }
62:     // Update packages
63:     for (let i = packages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
64:       const p = packages[i];
65:       p.y += p.speed;
66:       if (p.y + p.h > ship.y && p.x < ship.x + ship.w && p.x + p.w > ship.x) {
67:         beep(800, 0.1); // collect sound
68:         packages.splice(i, 1); // collect (no score tracking for brevity)
69:         continue;
70:       }
71:       if (p.y > H) packages.splice(i, 1);
72:     }
73:     // Timer
74:     timer -= dt / 1000;
75:     if (timer <= 0) endGame();
76:   }
77:   function draw() {
78:     // Background gradient
79:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
80:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
81:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
82:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
83:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
84:     // Stars
85:     stars.forEach(s => {
86:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
87:       ctx.beginPath();
88:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
89:       ctx.fill();
90:       s.y += 0.5;
91:       if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
92:     });
93:     // Ship (triangle)
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
102:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
103:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x + a.r, a.y + a.r, a.r * 0.2, a.x + a.r, a.y + a.r, a.r);
104:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
105:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
106:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
107:       ctx.beginPath();
108:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.r, a.y + a.r, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
109:       ctx.fill();
110:     });
111:     // Packages (rounded with gradient)
112:     packages.forEach(p => {
113:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x, p.y, p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
114:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
115:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c90');
116:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
117:       const radius = 3;
118:       ctx.beginPath();
119:       ctx.moveTo(p.x + radius, p.y);
120:       ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w - radius, p.y);
121:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + p.w, p.y, p.x + p.w, p.y + radius);
122:       ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h - radius);
123:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h, p.x + p.w - radius, p.y + p.h);
124:       ctx.lineTo(p.x + radius, p.y + p.h);
125:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x, p.y + p.h, p.x, p.y + p.h - radius);
126:       ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + radius);
127:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x, p.y, p.x + radius, p.y);
128:       ctx.closePath();
129:       ctx.fill();
130:     });
131:     // Timer display
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
134:     ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(timer), 10, 20);
135:   }
136:   let gameOver = false;
137:   function endGame() {
138:     beep(150, 0.5); // game over sound
139:     gameOver = true;
140:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
141:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
144:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
145:   }
146:   function loop(timestamp) {
147:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
148:     lastTime = timestamp;
149:     if (!gameOver) {
150:       update(dt);
151:       draw();
152:     }
153:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154:   }
155:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156: })();

(End of file - total 156 lines)
</content>
